assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.

Given the unspecified cardiac arrhythmia and concern for potential embolic events or hemodynamic instability, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmic activity.
This service addresses the documented diagnoses I34.0 and I49.9
This service directly supports the clinical indication for capturing continuous rhythm data to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic activity.
